a bench I always keep an eye on is **AA-Omniscience** and I was curious to see how much the new ckpt improved over the preview one:  
\- conditional hallucination rate: 96% -> 84%

interestingly, the accuracy didn't improve (37%), what changed is "uncertainty calibration", for the better.

So we have a model whose knowledge accuracy is on par for its size (very similar to gpt 5.6 luna!), but way more willingly to say "I don't know".

Even if benches like this focus on factual knowledge, it's an idea of how much aware you got to be when you throw these models in your codebase to do analysis, bug finding, etc
